gates.source: §4.5 compares fixed cadence, continuous flow and handling unplanned requests through explicit service classes; common visibility and fit to flow remain central. Pilot prices are explicit scenario evidence.
gates.family: PASS. Same 80 orders, month, role, quality and shared reporting. Only late confirmation count changes (1,8,40); mechanisms are mutually exclusive: wait for batch, central exception duty, event-driven local release. Shared status report does not turn third strategy into central exception handling. Addresses unresolved-72 nested-strategy finding.
gates.economics: 10n,20+2n,52+n,100. At n=1: 10/22/53/100. At 8: 80/36/60/100. At 40: 400/100/92/100. First crossover 2.5; duty best 3–31, equal to local at 32; local alone best 33–47, tie with vendor at 48; above 48 vendor wins. No tie for any assessed state.
gates.level: Middle. Uses measured frequency and fixed setup/variable waiting effects to select an operating process for one period within mandate. No Head governance or Senior uncertainty requirement.
gates.duplication: ALLOWED REINFORCEMENT: TC-076–078 alter optional quality review intensity and residual defect loss; this family fixes quality and chooses where scheduling occurs. TC-009/136/165 vary enforcement/readiness, proof paths or required principles; here same teams, same reporting, only demand timing varies. TC-215/242/296 diagnose an approval ceremony or isolate causal gate effects; here pilot measurements are given. gates.mapping: PASS. Identity, level, topic, pattern mappings, training-only status and family order preserved against both manifests. Swift maps delivery_quality→processes, gate-effect-diagnosis/quality-metrics→evidence, process-economics→proportionality. Measured waiting impact of the synchronization gate motivates the choice; quality held constant.

limitations: Projection approval only. Merge/freeze, full cases, blind QA, Swift validation of authored cases and import are separate. All three members are training-only.

The two boundaries refer to transitions across the three selected states; there is an additional vendor crossover outside them. A full case should distinguish three internal pilots from the external quote, and preserve all four alternatives.
